## 升级前请阅读 / Before upgrading

- 从数据库谱系不兼容的旧版本跨代升级前，请备份或导出重要数据；应用沿用既有的数据集重建规则，不转换历史数据，Agent 数据清理保留非 Agent 配置。使用已退役 Computer 契约的会话需新建会话，原历史保留，个人 Agent 请重新选择 Computer 动作。
- Back up or export important data before upgrading from an incompatible older database lineage. Existing dataset rebuild rules remain in effect without converting historical data; Agent clean cuts preserve non-Agent configuration. Retired Computer bindings require a new session and reselected actions for personal Agents; existing history is retained.

## 更新内容 / Highlights

- 模型选择与消费方能力对齐：任务、聊天语音输入与模型中心的模型列表只提供协议匹配的模型，语音转写路由按同样规则解析默认模型，避免选到不兼容的模型。

- Align model selection with consumer capabilities: task, chat speech input and model hub pickers only offer models whose protocols match the consuming feature, and the speech-to-text route resolves defaults the same way.
